english.title: Operate temporary or parallel interbus service without authorisation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) operated an international

(A)_[parallel]_
(B)_[temporary]_

service serving the same public as an existing regular service, namely **(..DESCRIBE SERVICE..), without authorisation in breach of Article 6(4) of the RSR Protocol
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1)(b) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.
